description: This file provides authentication utilities using JWT in a Flask-based web application. It includes functions for creating tokens, decoding them, extracting tokens from requests, and a decorator to enforce JWT authentication on route handlers.

methods.name: str create_access_token(identity: int, additional_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None)
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT access token with claims including subject, issued at, not before, expiration, and optional additional claims.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] decode_token(token: str)
methods.description: Decodes and validates a JWT token, raising Unauthorized errors if invalid or expired.

methods.name: str get_bearer_token_from_request()
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token string from the Authorization header of a Flask request.

methods.name: jwt_required(fn)
methods.description: A decorator that enforces JWT authentication on Flask route functions by verifying the token and injecting the user ID.

ctags.name: create_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def create_access_token(identity: int, additional_claims: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None) -> st/
